newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Comercial Mexicana starts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Comercial Mexicana starts.

text.p: -- Smith Barney said on Monday it had started Controladora Comercial Mexicana S.A. with a neutral, high-risk rating.
-- The firm established a earnings per global depositary share for the company of $1.95 and $1.41 for 1996 and 1997, respectively. The company earned $1.91 in 1995.

-- "Although a recent capital increase, which will be used to reduce debt, allows us to become more constructive with respect to this company's future growth potential, we believe that the stock at these levels already discounts many of the benefits of the reduced debt burden and thus limits any potential upside in the shares," analyst Alejandro Daniel Lerner wrote in a report.
-- "Moreover, Smith Barney's recent downgrade of the Mexican market ... caps our enthusiasm for making any new investments in Mexico at this time."
